learned: 2026-10-17: the WordPress media library holds ~1,236 report PDFs for AZ (742), NY (393) and NJ (22); filenames start with the state.
notes: Only NY-<FLAVOR>-B<batch>.pdf files are kept (link regex). The flavor is a code (POM, BSN, RB, MB, GF, KW, SB, HB, APL, BO, EB, CHRY, TAN, PR, PCH), not a name; the strain comes from the report's product line.
